units.source_text: 三公主容貌长得极美，时值豆蔻年华，姿态天真烂漫。

en.t: The Third Princess was extraordinarily beautiful, just at the tender age of early youth, with an innocent and unaffected grace.

units.source_text: 朱雀院看了，说道：

en.t: Suzaku-in looked at her and said:

units.source_text: “我要把这孩子托付给一个忠实可靠的人，

en.t: I want to entrust this child to someone loyal and dependable,

units.source_text: 其人须能真心疼爱她，原谅她的幼稚，好好地教养她。”

en.t: someone who can truly cherish her, forgive her childishness, and raise her with care.

units.source_text: 他召集几个老成懂事的乳母来，吩咐她们有关着裳式事宜，乘便言道：

en.t: He summoned several experienced and sensible nurses, gave them instructions about the coming skirt ceremony, and took the occasion to say:

units.source_text: “从前源氏大臣曾将式部卿亲王的女儿从小抚养大来。

en.t: Long ago, Minister Genji raised the daughter of Prince Shikibukyo from childhood.

units.source_text: 我也想找这样的一个人，把三公主托付给他才好。

en.t: I too would like to find such a person and entrust the Third Princess to him.

units.source_text: 在臣下中是难于找到的。

en.t: Among ordinary retainers, such a person is hard to find.

units.source_text: 皇上那里呢，已经有了秋好皇后。

en.t: As for His Majesty, he already has Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 其次的女御身份都很高贵。

en.t: The other consorts beneath her are all of very high rank as well.

units.source_text: 我出家后，三公主没有适当的后援人，入宫反而痛苦。

en.t: After I take holy orders, the Third Princess will have no proper supporter, so entering the palace would only bring her suffering.

units.source_text: 这中纳言未娶之时，我悔不向他示意，试探其心。

en.t: I regret that while this Chūnagon was still unmarried, I did not hint at my wishes and sound out his heart.

units.source_text: 此人年纪虽轻，才能甚强，前程很有望呢。”

en.t: Though he is young, he is highly talented and has a very promising future.

units.source_text: 乳母中的一人答道：

en.t: One of the nurses replied:

units.source_text: “中纳言为人一向诚实，多年以来，始终想念那位云居雁小姐，

en.t: The Chūnagon has always been sincere by nature, and for many years he has thought only of Lady Kumoi no Kari,

units.source_text: 从来不把爱情移向别人身上。

en.t: never once turning his love toward anyone else.

units.source_text: 如今好事既成，越发不会动心了。

en.t: Now that the marriage has happily taken place, he will be even less likely to let his heart wander.

units.source_text: 倒是他家老太爷，贪爱女色之心到现在还不消减呢。

en.t: Rather, it is the old lord of his house whose fondness for women has still not diminished.

units.source_text: 在女人之中，他最爱身份高贵的人。

en.t: Among women, he is especially drawn to those of noble rank.

units.source_text: 像那位前斋院槿姬，他至今也不忘记，常常写信去呢。”

en.t: For example, he still has not forgotten Princess Asagao, the former Saiin, and often sends letters to her.

units.source_text: 朱雀院说：“哎呀！老是轻薄贪色，也很讨厌。”

en.t: Suzaku-in said, Ah! To remain frivolous and lustful even in old age is quite distasteful.

units.source_text: 他口上虽如此说，但心里在想：加入许多夫人之中，虽然难免发生不快之事，

en.t: Although he said this aloud, inwardly he thought that if she joined the ranks of many wives, unpleasant matters would be hard to avoid,

units.source_text: 但我确信源氏是可代父亲的人，就照乳母之意，把三公主托付给他吧。

en.t: but I am certain that Genji can stand in a father's place, so I will follow the nurse's suggestion and entrust the Third Princess to him.

units.source_text: 便又说道：“实在，有了女儿而希望她多少经历些尘世的生涯，

en.t: Then he said again, Truly, if one has a daughter and wishes her to experience at least something of life in this world,

units.source_text: 则一样出嫁，不如教她去依附源氏。

en.t: then if she is to marry at all, it would be better to have her depend upon Genji.

units.source_text: 人生在世，寿命几何？

en.t: How long can a human life in this world really last?

units.source_text: 总该叫她度送源氏之家那样幸福的生活才是。

en.t: Surely I should let her spend her days in happiness, as one does in Genji's household.

units.source_text: 我若生为女人，即使同他是嫡亲兄妹，也定要嫁给他。

en.t: If I had been born a woman, even if he and I had been full brother and sister, I would still have wanted to marry him.

units.source_text: ——我年轻时确有此种想法呢。

en.t: That is truly how I thought when I was young.

units.source_text: 何况女人，被他所迷惑乃当然之理。”

en.t: How much more natural, then, that women should be captivated by him.

units.source_text: 他说这话时，心中定然想起尚侍胧月夜之事。

en.t: As he said this, he must surely have been thinking in his heart of the Naishi no Kami Oborozukiyo.
